summary.text: Tina Bojanowski is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky House District 32 who has served since January 1, 2019, and is running unopposed for re-election on November 3, 2026. She is an educator with Jefferson County Public Schools.

paragraphs.text: Tina Bojanowski was born August 29, 1964, and as of February 2020 lived in Louisville, Kentucky.
She earned a bachelor of science and an MBA in management from the University of Louisville, and a MAT and a Ph.D. in education from Bellarmine University.

Her career experience includes working as an educator with Jefferson County Public Schools, and she has been a member of the Jefferson County Teaching Association Board of Directors and the National Alliance on Mental Illness Kentucky Board of Directors.
Bojanowski succeeded Republican Phil Moffett in District 32.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Appropriations and Revenue, Families and Children, and Primary and Secondary Education committees.
